name: Hellbound
description: Unearthly beings deliver bloody condemnations, sending individuals to hell and giving rise to a religious group founded on the idea of divine justice.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Horrified bystanders watch as otherworldly beasts chase down and kill a man in broad daylight. Jung Jinsu declares that only sinners are sent to hell.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The New Truth offers a sizable payment to Park Jungja, a condemned woman, in exchange for the right to live-broadcast the moment her fate is decided.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Addressing a stunned world, Jinsu preaches righteousness. Detective Jin Kyunghun searches for his missing daughter. The Arrowhead targets Min Hyejin.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Bae Youngjae follows his co-worker to a fishing dock, where he witnesses a terrifying sight. The Prophet Angel appears in an unthinkable place.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: A despairing Youngjae tracks down a man who he thinks might have answers. The New Truth catches wind of a mysterious organization with its own agenda.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: With detrimental information hanging over its head, The New Truth scrambles to protect its power by preventing the public from learning the truth.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: After a series of visions, Jinsu finds himself mysteriously resurrected. Realizing he's losing power, Kim Jeongchil agrees to work with the government.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: While in hiding, Kyunghun and his daughter suddenly come under attack. Meanwhile, the New Truth accelerates their announcement plan.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Jeongchil manipulates Jungja to carry out the New Will. As Jinsu learns more about Cheon Sehyeong, he begins to form his escape plan.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Jinsu puts forward his plot to come face to face with Jungja. However, Hyejin decides to carry out her own rescue plan to retrieve Jungja for Sodo.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: As Hyejin, Jinsu and Jeongchil all try to grab ahold of Jungja, Senior Secretary Lee plays her own game on the sidelines — but chaos arises everywhere.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Jinsu confronts Jungja, desperately searching for answers. But as disorder unfolds, will Hyejin be able to get Jungja to safety before it's too late?
